# Formal Languages & Grammar

This section explores the intersection of number theory and formal language
theory, specifically applying grammar rules to sequences like the Collatz
conjecture.

## 🔢 Collatz & String Rewriting

- **Grammar Construction**:
  - `collatz_grammar_almost_done.wls`: Mapping the Collatz process $(3n+1, n/2)$
    to a set of production rules.
  - `grammar_deconstruction.wls`: Analyzing the structure of the resulting
    "languages" generated by these sequences.
  - `grammar_minimal.wls`: A simplified version of the grammar models.
- **State Machines**:
  - `iteration_as_FSM.wls`: Treating the state transitions of an iterated
    function as a Finite State Machine.
  - `lang_id_at_limit.wls`: Investigating the properties of the language as the
    number of iterations goes to infinity.

## 🛠 Related Experiments

- `grammar_but_it_doesnt_end.wls`
- `trees.wls`: Visualizing the tree structure of grammar applications.
- `odd_even_odd_eq_proof.wls`: Algebraic proofs related to the parity patterns.
